subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should manual `/new` and hard `/reset` require a default-on confirmation across Control UI typed input, TUI, Gateway/channel command paths, and should any opt-out config exist?
rationale: The implementation path is bounded, but the change alters public command semantics and may add config/default surface that OpenClaw policy treats as product-sensitive.

options.title: Default-on single confirmation
options.body: Require one repeated command or explicit confirm action before destructive manual resets, without adding config unless a concrete opt-out need is approved.

options.title: Configurable confirmation
options.body: Add documented configuration for confirmation behavior and accept the schema, docs, migration, and upgrade-review burden.

options.title: Keep commands immediate
options.body: Leave typed `/new` and `/reset` unchanged and focus on session preservation or recovery improvements elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Default-on single confirmation
recommendation.body: Require one repeated command or explicit confirm action before destructive manual resets, without adding config unless a concrete opt-out need is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest recent history across the existing confirmation guard and the current reset command paths.
